subject: PHPStan, Pint, PHPUnit and other checks
version6: purpose verification with the read or edit class of the check
reason: Plan 14 decision D13: one Tests and checks purpose for every check, with its own contract

subject: git branch -D and git branch --delete
reason: Deleting a branch removes a ref, so the delete class must be granted

subject: git ls-remote, fetch, pull and push
reason: They reach a remote, so the network class must be granted

subject: A redirect to a file
version5: the class of the program alone
version6: the program's classes plus write for the redirect target
reason: Doc 21 revision 6, section 6: a redirect writes its file whatever the program does

subject: composer, npm and pnpm scripts
version5: matched by script name as a text prefix
version6: each body line classified as its own child, unknown without a package file
reason: Doc 21 revision 6, sections 67 and 68: a script is what its body runs, never what its name says; the corpus root has no package file, so its scripts stay unknown

subject: Version 5 journal commands
version6: unknown subcommand unless the route is registered in version 6
reason: Only this installation's registered routes are known (task 443)

subject: python, node, perl, awk, eval and source
reason: They run source the analysis cannot see; a reviewed rule must declare a script before it is known

subject: Type generation such as types:generate and wayfinder:generate
reason: Plan 14 decision D13: generating files is a build, never verification

subject: cd, export and sleep
reason: They change only the shell's own state or wait, so they need no grant
